data.name: Boudhayan
data.gender_notes: Boudhayan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Boudhayan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Bodh', meaning 'to wake up' or 'to enlighten'. The suffix 'ayan' means 'one who leads' or 'one who has knowledge'. This name is often given to a child who is expected to become a wise and knowledgeable leader in the future. The name Boudhayan carries the meaning “Wise, intelligent, scholarly” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Boudhayan usually hope their child will grow to embody wise, intelligent, scholarly and live with faith, good character and purpose.
